sections.heading: Why visit Shimla
paragraphs: Shimla (Himachal Pradesh) is known for its hills, heritage and family experiences. Overall it is mid-range — comfortable stays and good food without overspending.

paragraphs: The best time to visit is March to June, and December to January for snow.

faq.q: When is the best time to visit Shimla?

faq.q: Where should I stay in Shimla?
faq.a: Popular choices: Near the Mall for walkability; Chharabra / Mashobra for forest retreats; Kufri for snow views.
